what: An A/A run: the same 10 with_skill slots on the two core restraint twins, re-dispatched with materials byte-identical to the study's own (method.md sha256 a0a57067... verified equal to the study bundle). Nothing changed. It measures how much apparent movement pure resampling produces.
why: The MT-2026-08-19 micro-test recorded a confound against itself: its 6/10 baseline was a single sample, so a change that produced 6/10 could not be told from one that did nothing. This is that missing control.
headline: FIVE OF TEN SLOTS FLIPPED LABEL WITH NO CHANGE WHATSOEVER.

what_it_establishes.1_individual_slot_labels_are_near_coin_f: On these restraint twins an individual slot's held/over_flagged label reproduces about half the time. No conclusion may rest on what a single slot did. Two of the four slots the clause appeared to 'fix' (pair-006, pair-009) flip to held at unchanged prose as well.
what_it_establishes.2_aggregate_rate_is_stable_to_about_one_: study 6/10, A/A 5/10, micro-test 6/10 -- all within 1 of each other, because flips run both directions. So the aggregate rate is the reportable quantity and the per-slot label is not.
what_it_establishes.3_the_clause_rejection_is_confirmed: The clause's 4-slot swing sits inside a noise band that moves 5 slots on its own. REJECTED stands, now measured rather than inferred.
what_it_establishes.4_a_number_for_the_repo: First A/A datapoint in this repo. Any claimed improvement on a 10-slot restraint panel must beat roughly +-1 in aggregate rate; a 4-slot reshuffle is nothing.

consequence_for_the_paired_arm_study.restraint_lift_SURVIVES: principal-invariant-owner-restraint measured with 5/5 vs without 1/5 -- a 4-slot ARM-TO-ARM gap in aggregate rate, far outside the +-1 reproducibility bound. The study's one positive finding is unaffected.
consequence_for_the_paired_arm_study.crossplat_flag_negative_is_now_QUESTIONA: That result is bare 5/5 vs skill 4/5 -- a ONE-slot aggregate difference, i.e. at or below the reproducibility bound measured here. It should not have been read as a signal worth investigating, and the diagnosis effort spent on it was probably spent on noise.
consequence_for_the_paired_arm_study.caveat_on_transferring_this_estimate: The estimate was measured on RESTRAINT twins, which sit mid-range and are free to move in both directions. The flag scenarios saturate near 5/5 on both arms, a regime with less room to vary, so this noise band is NOT established for them. Treat the crossplat-flag downgrade as indicated, not proven.
consequence_for_the_paired_arm_study.what_is_NOT_being_done: Decision 3 is NOT being unblocked and Decision 4's flag row is NOT being rewritten. Those were routed by a frozen rule on committed data, and retroactively reversing a decision because a later measurement makes its trigger look like noise is exactly the post-hoc move the preregistration exists to prevent. This is recorded as the input the NEXT preregistration should carry.

cost: 20 agent dispatches (10 arms + 10 grades), roughly 1.5M tokens.
next_time: Before any prose micro-test on this panel, budget for the A/A arm alongside it. A treatment run without its own control was worth less than half of what the pair is worth.
